instructions:
## Task objective

Curate a 10,000-row instruction-tuning subset of the Tülu-3 SFT mixture (allenai/tulu-3-sft-mixture, ~939K rows; columns {messages, id, source}) so a LoRA-SFT OLMo-2-1B (base) performs as well as possible on the Tülu-3 development eval suite. Budget is 10K rows. Baselines: random and the published Tülu-3 mixing recipe (source-stratified; see curation/tulu3_recipe/curate.py). EVAL SCOPE: this task's target_evals are the Tülu-3 dev benchmarks that run on the OFFLINE GPU compute node (no remote judge, no code execution): MMLU (0-shot EM), GSM8K (8-shot EM), BBH (3-shot EM), MATH (4-shot flex EM), TruthfulQA (MC2), IFEval (prompt-loose pass@1). The remaining published dev metrics are wired in the eval backend but excluded here because they need capabilities the offline compute node lacks: - HumanEval / HumanEval+ (pass@10): in-process CODE EXECUTION (Tier B) — run on a code-exec-capable node; benchmarks "HumanEval"/"HumanEvalPlus". - AlpacaEval 2 (LC win rate): OpenAI GPT-4 JUDGE (Tier C) — run inside the visual-node container with network; benchmark "AlpacaEval2". - DROP, PopQA, Tülu-3 Safety: not in the vendored open-instruct eval package (DROP/PopQA live in oe-eval; Safety is a separate suite) — a documented provisioning follow-up (see the plan doc). Absolute scores track the vendored open-instruct implementations, not the paper's oe-eval numbers exactly.

## Controlled curation loop

Inspect the supplied pool and implement a selection policy in the editable curation workspace. Produce the requested subset with the required schema, run the audit, and submit it through the benchmark CLI. The harness trains the fixed base model using the prescribed recipe and evaluates the checkpoint. Use the returned feedback to revise the selection policy. Do not alter the protected training or evaluation implementation.

## Exact published task configuration

```yaml
task:
  task_id: tulu3_olmo2_1b_devsuite
  domain: text
  goal: >
    Curate a 10,000-row instruction-tuning subset of the Tülu-3 SFT mixture
    (allenai/tulu-3-sft-mixture, ~939K rows; columns {messages, id, source}) so a
    LoRA-SFT OLMo-2-1B (base) performs as well as possible on the Tülu-3
    development eval suite. Budget is 10K rows. Baselines: `random` and the
    published Tülu-3 mixing recipe (source-stratified; see
    curation/tulu3_recipe/curate.py).

    EVAL SCOPE: this task's target_evals are the Tülu-3 dev benchmarks that run
    on the OFFLINE GPU compute node (no remote judge, no code execution):
    MMLU (0-shot EM), GSM8K (8-shot EM), BBH (3-shot EM), MATH (4-shot flex EM),
    TruthfulQA (MC2), IFEval (prompt-loose pass@1). The remaining published dev
    metrics are wired in the eval backend but excluded here because they need
    capabilities the offline compute node lacks:
      - HumanEval / HumanEval+ (pass@10): in-process CODE EXECUTION (Tier B) —
        run on a code-exec-capable node; benchmarks "HumanEval"/"HumanEvalPlus".
      - AlpacaEval 2 (LC win rate): OpenAI GPT-4 JUDGE (Tier C) — run inside the
        visual-node container with network; benchmark "AlpacaEval2".
      - DROP, PopQA, Tülu-3 Safety: not in the vendored open-instruct eval
        package (DROP/PopQA live in oe-eval; Safety is a separate suite) — a
        documented provisioning follow-up (see the plan doc).
    Absolute scores track the vendored open-instruct implementations, not the
    paper's oe-eval numbers exactly.
  target_rows: 10000
  training_stage: finetuning
  model_key: olmo2-1b
  model_name_or_path: __MODEL_PATH__
  target_evals:
    - MMLU
    - GSM8K
    - BBH
    - MATH
    - TruthfulQA
    - IFEval
  strategy_timeout_seconds: null
  default_submission_dir: curated/final_submission
  training_config:
    # One full epoch over the curated 10K subset; LoRA SFT (curation-train
    # TEXT_SFT defaults). num_processes drives a single-GPU run.
    num_processes: 1
    warmup_ratio: 0.03
    timeout_seconds: 14400
  eval_config:
    benchmarks:
      - MMLU
      - GSM8K
      - BBH
      - MATH
      - TruthfulQA
      - IFEval
    offline: true
    mode: all
    timeout_seconds: 36000
    gpu_id: 0
    # Tülu-3 evaluates MMLU 0-shot (the spec's MMLU is 5-shot for LESS).
    eval_options:
      ntrain: 0
  dataset:
    dataset_id: tulu3
    local_path: __DATASET_PATH__
    split: null
```

Configuration source: [curation-bench/src/benchmark/tasks/tulu3_olmo2_1b_devsuite.yaml](https://github.com/Jiachen-T-Wang/curation-bench-pro/blob/fb418bc9ce1c52416550ba6abf5968d8d594c760/curation-bench/src/benchmark/tasks/tulu3_olmo2_1b_devsuite.yaml), [Apache-2.0 license](https://github.com/Jiachen-T-Wang/curation-bench-pro/blob/fb418bc9ce1c52416550ba6abf5968d8d594c760/LICENSE).
